text: {"assertions":["On 2026-01-23, a missing step issue was discovered in the funnel report in analytics/dashboards/funnel.py.","The missing step in the funnel report only affected clients still using the v1 SDK.","The root cause was the config loader reading the wrong environment file.","The issue could be reproduced by building the funnel for a two-week window.","The bug manifested as a stage with zero users appearing between two populated stages.","The fix made environment selection explicit and implemented closed failure behavior on ambiguity (PR #1600, branch fix/missing-step-1).","A related flaky test improved from 22 failures per 100 runs to zero failures after the fix.","This work was in the same area of the codebase as earlier missing step work, allowing context to carry over."]}
